expect.asks_about: Which person in the photo is the user: the bearded man on the left or the short-haired blonde woman on the right?

item.title: Choose The Right Headshot Subject

turns.text: Can you make me a square professional headshot from this?

item.tests: Clarifies the intended person in a two-person source before producing a single identity-preserving headshot.

answer_sheet.Which person: I'm the woman with short blonde hair on the right.
answer_sheet.Style and expression: Natural and professional; keep my smile.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: No particular platform; square, 640 × 640 is fine.

must_haves: The only person in the final portrait is the short-haired blonde woman from the right of two-friends.jpg.
Her face, short blonde hairstyle and smile remain recognisable from the source.
The man is entirely absent, including any partial face, shoulder or arm.
The beach setting and casual presentation are replaced with professional clothing and an unobtrusive backdrop.
The output is a square head-and-shoulders portrait with natural-looking lighting and no visible editing artifacts.

turns.text: Could you make me a professional headshot from this pic? I've been meaning to get a proper headshot sorted out for a while. The thing I nearly forgot to mention in the middle of all this is that I'd like it to be square. I'm just a little nervous about how it'll turn out, since I don't usually know what makes a good headshot.

dialog.agent:
Absolutely—I’ll make it square, with flattering soft lighting and a clean, professional background while keeping you looking natural.

Which person are you: the person on the **left** or the **right**?
dialog.why: It asks which person the user is—left or right—and waits for that information.
dialog.user: I'm the woman with short blonde hair on the right. I'd like it to look natural and professional, and please keep my smile. I don't have a particular platform in mind; square at 640 × 640 would be fine.

turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the headshot because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was created.

Once credits are available, I can retry your **640 × 640 square headshot**, preserving your smile and short blonde hair, with soft lighting and a neutral professional background.
